coverage_limits: Radius scans at conventions a,b and SvdW radius scans were reproduced with author code; own independently recomputed saved radius scan covers c lower/W09. Full a,b closure and interval tables were independently checked.
Existing wall-internal 0.834/0.935 summary numbers are imported from 1G-C and were not independently reconstructed in this new H numerical calculation.
Individual 121-point propagator plotting arrays reproduced across interpreters; independent saved outputs verify integrated scale dependence and low-k values rather than every plotting abscissa.
Mass-fraction finite-difference numbers in artifact compared to independent analytical derivative; author finite-difference routine itself is not an independent implementation.
No CAMB/CLASS computation; no claim for physical accuracy of EH98 import or universal anchor correction.
All observational matching, tracer, nonlinear dynamics and positive-density completions remain outside numerical verification.
method_notes: Saved independent computation has no production imports; tracker, spectrum and window equations independently coded. Input parameter choices and closure conventions intentionally match the author.
Author evidence was run independently on two interpreters, but both execute the same scientific implementation; that verifies reproduction, not derivation.

Cross-method tolerance chosen for the scientific/display question and explicitly recorded; not represented as a pre-registered audit test. Core calculations use 2e-8 absolute plus 2e-8 relative, covariance targets the reported 3 decimal places.
Independent saved Av is p0/fi; author void_onset_response_A_v excludes the compression term for compressed PBS.
Report fractional As derivatives are finite logarithmic changes, not exact local derivatives.
Half-last-digit rounding deviations checked against both independent and author unrounded values.
Covariance signed-Gaussian feasibility and reclosure calibration questions are mathematically separate from numerical agreement.
